title: System status

health.healthyHint: Vehicle data is being read and stored normally.
health.degradedHint: Data is still being read, but storage is falling behind or the database is unreachable.
health.downHint: No successful read from the vehicle feed in the last 30 seconds.

refreshFailed: The latest refresh failed. Showing the last data received.
loadError: Could not load the system status.

empty.title: No successful read yet
empty.hint: The backend is running but has not read the vehicle feed successfully. This page updates automatically.

lastRead.label: Last successful read
lastRead.ago: {seconds, plural, =0 {just now} one {# second ago} other {# seconds ago}}

rowsLastHour.label: Rows written in the last hour
rowsLastHour.unavailable: Unknown while the database is unreachable

entities.label: Last read
entities.total: {count, plural, one {# entity} other {# entities}} in the feed

spool.label: Pending spool batches
spool.hint: Read but not yet written to the database

tripUpdatesRead.label: Trip updates: last read
tripUpdatesRead.none: Trip updates have not been read yet

trackedTrips.label: Trips with realtime data
trackedTrips.hint: Trips that currently have a realtime schedule

webSocketTraffic.label: WebSocket traffic (last minute)
webSocketTraffic.hint: {clients, plural, =0 {No clients connected} one {Sent to # client} other {Sent to # clients in total}}

freshness.title: How recently vehicles reported
freshness.hint: Vehicles silent for more than {stale} minutes are taken off the live map (usually their trip has ended); their history is kept for 3 hours.
freshness.summary: {onMap, number} of {total, number} vehicles are on the map.
